title: Nehemiah’s Final Reforms

questions.question: What was read from the Book of Moses in the hearing of the people?
options: That no Ammonite or Moabite should ever enter the assembly of God
questions.correctAnswer: That no Ammonite or Moabite should ever enter the assembly of God
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 13:1 (ESV): "...it was found written in it that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever enter the assembly of God..."

questions.question: Why were Ammonites and Moabites excluded?
options: For they did not meet the people of Israel with bread and water, but hired Balaam against them
questions.correctAnswer: For they did not meet the people of Israel with bread and water, but hired Balaam against them
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 13:2 (ESV): "for they did not meet the people of Israel with bread and water..."

questions.question: Who had provided a large chamber for Tobiah in the temple?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 13:4-5 (ESV): "Now before this, Eliashib the priest... having been connected with Tobiah, prepared for him a large chamber..."

questions.question: What did Nehemiah do when he found out about Tobiah's chamber?
options: He threw all of Tobiah's household furniture out of the chamber
questions.correctAnswer: He threw all of Tobiah's household furniture out of the chamber
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 13:8 (ESV): "...and I threw all the household furniture of Tobiah out of the chamber."

questions.question: Why had the Levites fled to their fields?
options: Because the portions of the Levites had not been given to them
questions.correctAnswer: Because the portions of the Levites had not been given to them
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 13:10 (ESV): "I also found out that the portions of the Levites had not been given to them..."

questions.question: What were people doing on the Sabbath that angered Nehemiah?
options: Treading winepresses, bringing in grain, and selling food
questions.correctAnswer: Treading winepresses, bringing in grain, and selling food
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 13:15 (ESV): "In those days I saw in Judah people treading winepresses on the Sabbath..."

questions.question: What did Nehemiah do to stop Sabbath trade?
options: He commanded that the gates should be shut and not opened until after the Sabbath
questions.correctAnswer: He commanded that the gates should be shut and not opened until after the Sabbath
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 13:19 (ESV): "...I commanded that the gates should be shut and gave orders that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath."

questions.question: Who did Nehemiah discover had married foreign women?
options: Jews who had married women of Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab
questions.correctAnswer: Jews who had married women of Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 13:23 (ESV): "In those days also I saw the Jews who had married women of Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab."

questions.question: What language could half of their children not speak?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 13:24 (ESV): "And half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod, and they could not speak the language of Judah..."

questions.question: Who did Nehemiah chase away?
options: One of the sons of Joiada... son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite
questions.correctAnswer: One of the sons of Joiada... son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 13:28 (ESV): "And one of the sons of Joiada... was son-in-law to Sanballat... Therefore I chased him from me."

questions.question: What example of sin did Nehemiah use to warn the people about foreign wives?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 13:26 (ESV): "Did not Solomon king of Israel sin on account of such women?..."

questions.question: What did Nehemiah do to some of the men who had married foreign women?
options: Contended with them, cursed them, beat some of them, and pulled out their hair
questions.correctAnswer: Contended with them, cursed them, beat some of them, and pulled out their hair
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 13:25 (ESV): "And I contended with them and cursed them and beat some of them and pulled out their hair..."

questions.question: What recurring prayer does Nehemiah pray throughout this chapter?
Why did Nehemiah have to return to the king?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 13:6 (ESV): "...for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes... I went to the king..."

questions.question: What was Nehemiah's final request in the book?
options: Remember me, O my God, for good
questions.correctAnswer: Remember me, O my God, for good
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 13:31 (ESV): "Remember me, O my God, for good."

key_verse_text: And I provided for the wood offering at appointed times, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.
